map.解析：跳过空行与以 ; 或 # 开头的注释行；以 [ 开头且以 ] 结尾的行视为: Parsing: skip blank lines and comment lines starting with ; or #; a line starting with [ and ending with ] is a section name and creates an empty object for that section (if the same section already exists, merge into that object and let the later value override the same key); other lines use the first = as the key/value separator, with the left part as the key and the right part as the value, both trimmed; if there is a current section write into it, otherwise write at the root. Reverse output: when the value is a plain object, write [section] first, then one "child key = value" line per entry and append a blank line at the end of the section; otherwise write "key = value" directly, and finally trim the whole output
